topic.title: Can we use the Kaggle Benchmarks AI quota to generate training data?
topic.content:
Hi! Every Kaggle account gets free AI quota for Kaggle Benchmarks, and the Model Proxy includes some of the candidate models from this competition.

Is it allowed to use this free quota to generate extra training data?

comments.content: Yes, I don't think they've denied the use of Kaggle AI quota :) feel free to use it.
